_README.purpose: Maps each reference image's repo path to a download spec. The build_references.py script reads this and downloads each image (running on GitHub Actions for unrestricted internet access).
_README.format_search: { "<path>.jpg": { "search": "player name product card#" } }  — eBay search, script auto-finds image
_README.running: Click 'Actions' tab → 'Build Reference Library' → 'Run workflow'. The action runs the script on GitHub's servers (no network restrictions) and commits any new images.
_README.tip: Parallel references just need ANY card showing that pattern — player doesn't matter. Base photos need the EXACT card.
